about: Marches on an enemy castle or town, waits near it for the named lords if you give any, then besieges it. The game assaults once the siege engines are ready.
calls_back: a relief army comes near, the siege is won, or it is broken

wait_hours: how long to wait near it for the named lords
relief_ratio: call back when an enemy army this many times its strength comes near
relief_radius: how near counts for that, in map units

when.poke: {at} is no longer an enemy holding.
{at} is no longer an enemy holding.
{me} waited {wait_hours} hours near {at}; {lords_arrived()} of {lords_count()} lords came. Besieging now.
{at} is no longer an enemy holding.

when.if: hours_in_state > 6 and not besieging and not within(at, 3)
army_near(at, relief_radius) != none and army_near(at, relief_radius) != reported and strength_of(army_near(at, relief_radius)) >= strength * relief_ratio
when.poke: A relief army is coming to {at}: {army_near(at, relief_radius)}, strength {strength_of(army_near(at, relief_radius))} against {me}'s {strength}.
